regions.today: It will be mostly cloudy this evening with scattered outbreaks of rain and drizzle, but drier and brighter conditions in the northwest of the province will gradually extend southwards, in light to moderate northerly winds.
regions.tonight: Rain and drizzle will gradually push away to the southeast tonight, with clear spells developing. Towards morning, isolated showers will develop in the northwest of the province. A few patches of mist and fog may also form overnight. It will be colder than previous nights, with lowest temperatures ranging from 2 to 6 degrees, in a light west to northwesterly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be a bright day with plenty of sunshine and some scattered showers spreading from the northwest in the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees, with a freshening northwesterly breeze.
